page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor. It features 24 physical cores and 24 vCPUs running at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz, supported by 35 MB of L3 cache. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying on KVM virtualization and delivering an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

Benchmark data places this server in the average performance tier across multiple workloads. In CPU-focused tests, it achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1438.39 and a multi-core score of 23015.19, alongside a Geekbench multi-core score of 9875.0. Memory bandwidth tests show read-only speeds of 1282.13 GB/sec for small cached blocks and 109.43 GB/sec for large uncached blocks. For database and key-value operations, the instance handles 22.14 million Redis SET operations per second and scores 8647.45 in PassMark database operations.

Lacking local NVMe storage and GPU accelerators, the ecs.hfg6.6xlarge is not configured for heavy storage-bound databases or large-scale deep learning training. However, its dedicated Intel Xeon cores with AVX-512 support make it a cost-efficient option for compute-heavy workloads that do not require local disk persistence. It is well-aligned with workloads such as static web serving, software compilation, medium-sized LLM inference, and general-purpose enterprise applications.
